lines.gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sahaje naam dhiaaeeai giaan paragat hoi ||1||
lines.translation: Meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, with intuitive ease and poise, spiritual wisdom is revealed. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਏ ਮਨ ਮਤ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਦੂਰਿ ਹੈ ਸਦਾ ਵੇਖੁ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: e man mat jaanahi har door hai sadaa vekh hadoor ||
lines.translation: O my mind, do not think of the Lord as being far away; behold Him ever close at hand.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦ ਸੁਣਦਾ ਸਦ ਵੇਖਦਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sad sunadaa sad vekhadaa sabad rahiaa bharapoor ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: He is always listening, and always watching over us; the Word of His Shabad is all-pervading everywhere. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਤਿਨੑੀ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh aap pachhaaniaa tinhee ik man dhiaaiaa ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukhs understand their own selves; they meditate single-mindedly on the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਰਵਹਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਸਚੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: sadaa ravahi pir aapanaa sachai naam sukh paaiaa ||2||
lines.translation: They enjoy their Husband Lord continually; through the True Name, they find peace. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਏ ਮਨ ਤੇਰਾ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: e man teraa ko nahee kar vekh sabad veechaar ||
lines.translation: O my mind, no one belongs to you; contemplate the Shabad, and see this.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਭਜਿ ਪਉ ਪਾਇਹਿ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: har saranaaee bhaj pau paaihi mokh duaar ||3||
lines.translation: So run to the Lord's Sanctuary, and find the gate of salvation. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੁਝੀਐ ਸਚਿ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabad suneeai sabad bujheeai sach rahai liv laai ||
lines.translation: Listen to the Shabad, and understand the Shabad, and lovingly focus your consciousness on the True One.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੀਐ ਸਚੈ ਮਹਲਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: sabade haumai maareeai sachai mahal sukh paai ||4||
lines.translation: Through the Shabad, conquer your ego, and in the True Mansion of the Lord's Presence, you shall find peace. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸੋਭ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: is jug mahi sobhaa naam kee bin naavai sobh na hoi ||
lines.translation: In this age, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is glory; without the Name, there is no glory.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਚਾਰਿ ਦਿਹਾੜੇ ਜਾਦੀ ਬਿਲਮੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: ih maaiaa kee sobhaa chaar dihaaRe jaadee bilam na hoi ||5||
lines.translation: The glory of this Maya lasts for only a few days; it disappears in an instant. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਸੇ ਮੁਏ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jinee naam visaariaa se mue mar jaahi ||
lines.translation: Those who forget the Naam are already dead, and they continue dying.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਸਾਦੁ ਨ ਆਇਓ ਬਿਸਟਾ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: har ras saad na aaio bisataa maahi samaahi ||6||
lines.translation: They do not enjoy the sublime essence of the Lord's taste; they sink into the manure. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਅਨੁ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੇ ਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik aape bakhas milaaian anadin naame laai ||
lines.translation: Some are forgiven by the Lord; He unites them with Himself, and keeps them attached to the Naam, night and day.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਸਚਿ ਰਹਹਿ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: sach kamaavahi sach rahahi sache sach samaahi ||7||
lines.translation: They practice Truth, and abide in Truth; being truthful, they merge into Truth. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਨ ਦੇਖੀਐ ਜਗੁ ਬੋਲਾ ਅੰਨੑਾ ਭਰਮਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin sabadai suneeai na dekheeai jag bolaa a(n)nhaa bharamaai ||
lines.translation: Without the Shabad, the world does not hear, and does not see; deaf and blind, it wanders around.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਸੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਿਸੈ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: bin naavai dukh paaisee naam milai tisai rajaai ||8||
lines.translation: Without the Naam, it obtains only misery; the Naam is received only by His Will. ||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin baanee siu chit laaiaa se jan niramal paravaan ||
lines.translation: Those persons who link their consciousness with the Word of His Bani, are immaculately pure, and approved by the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਸੇ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੇ ਜਾਣੁ ॥੯॥੧੩॥੩੫॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam tinhaa kade na veesarai se dar sache jaan ||9||13||35||
lines.translation: O Nanak, they never forget the Naam, and in the Court of the Lord, they are known as true. ||9||13||35||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 3 ||
lines.translation: Aasaa, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੌ ਹੀ ਭਗਤ ਜਾਪਦੇ ਜਿਨੑ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਚੀ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabadau hee bhagat jaapade jinh kee baanee sachee hoi ||
lines.translation: Through the Word of the Shabad, the devotees are known; their words are true.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਇਆ ਨਾਉ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਸਚਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: vichahu aap gaiaa naau ma(n)niaa sach milaavaa hoi ||1||
lines.translation: They eradicate ego from within themselves; they surrender to the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and meet with the True One. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: har har naam jan kee pat hoi ||
lines.translation: Through the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, His humble servants obtain honor.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਫਲੁ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਕਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਹੈ ਤਿਨੑ ਮਾਨੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: saphal tinhaa kaa janam hai tinh maanai sabh koi ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: How blessed is their coming into the world! Everyone adores them. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਜਾਤਿ ਹੈ ਅਤਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: haumai meraa jaat hai at krodh abhimaan ||
lines.translation: Ego, self-centeredness, excessive anger and pride are the lot of mankind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ ਤਾ ਜਾਤਿ ਜਾਇ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਭਗਵਾਨੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: sabad marai taa jaat jaai jotee jot milai bhagavaan ||2||
lines.translation: If one dies in the Word of the Shabad, then he is rid of this, and his light is merged into the Light of the Lord God. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਸਫਲ ਜਨਮੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: pooraa satigur bhetiaa saphal janam hamaaraa ||
lines.translation: Meeting with the Perfect True Guru, my life has been blessed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਵੈ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਭਰੇ ਅਖੁਟ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: naam navai nidh paaiaa bhare akhut bha(n)daaraa ||3||
lines.translation: I have obtained the nine treasures of the Naam, and my storehouse is inexhaustible, filled to overflowing. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਵਹਿ ਇਸੁ ਰਾਸੀ ਕੇ ਵਾਪਾਰੀਏ ਜਿਨੑਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: aavahi is raasee ke vaapaareee jinhaa naam piaaraa ||
lines.translation: Those who love the Naam come as dealers in the merchandise of the Naam.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਏ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh hovai so dhan paae tinhaa a(n)tar sabad veechaaraa ||4||
lines.translation: Those who become Gurmukh obtain this wealth; deep within, they contemplate the Shabad. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੑੀ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhagatee saar na jaananhee manamukh aha(n)kaaree ||
lines.translation: The egotistical, self-willed manmukhs do not appreciate the value of devotional worship.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧੁਰਹੁ ਆਪਿ ਖੁਆਇਅਨੁ ਜੂਐ ਬਾਜੀ ਹਾਰੀ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: dhurahu aap khuaaian jooai baajee haaree ||5||
lines.translation: The Primal Lord Himself has beguiled them; they lose their lives in the gamble. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਪਿਆਰੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਨਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ਸਰੀਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin piaarai bhagat na hovaee naa sukh hoi sareer ||
lines.translation: Without loving affection, devotional worship is not possible, and the body cannot be at peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰ ਭਗਤੀ ਮਨ ਧੀਰਿ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: prem padaarath paaeeai gur bhagatee man dheer ||6||
lines.translation: The wealth of love is obtained from the Guru; through devotion, the mind becomes steady. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਾਏ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਗੁਰਸਬਦ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis no bhagat karaae so kare gurasabad veechaar ||
lines.translation: He alone performs devotional worship, whom the Lord so blesses; he contemplates the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਮਾਰਿ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: hiradai eko naam vasai haumai dubidhaa maar ||7||
lines.translation: The One Name abides in his heart, and he conquers his ego and duality. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਾ ਕੀ ਜਤਿ ਪਤਿ ਏਕੋੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਸਵਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhagataa kee jat pat ekou naam hai aape lae savaar ||
lines.translation: The One Name is the social status and honor of the devotees; the Lord Himself adorns them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਸਾਰਿ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: sadaa saranaaee tis kee jiu bhaavai tiu kaaraj saar ||8||
lines.translation: They remain forever in the Protection of His Sanctuary. As it pleases His Will, He arranges their affairs. ||8||
